Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification step is now complete. To account for this, we've adjusted the delivery date to 14 April.

The additional time has been used to confirm the integration meets the required standards, so the certification will not need to be revisited later in the process. Our team has reviewed the remaining tasks against the new date and is confident it reflects an achievable path to completion, with normal progress updates continuing in the meantime.

Does 14 April still work well with your own scheduling and any downstream plans on your end? Please let us know if there's anything on your side we should factor in, and we'll keep you posted as we move toward delivery.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
